title: Workflows API hooks + types
description: useWorkflows(), useWorkflow(id), useCreateWorkflow(), useDeleteWorkflow(), useRuns(workflowId), useAllRuns(filters), useRun(id), useRunTimeline(id), useStartRun(), useRerunRun().

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkflows.ts: useWorkflows() fetching GET /api/v1/workflows with pagination. useWorkflow(id) single detail. useCreateWorkflow() mutation (POST /api/v1/workflows). useUpdateWorkflow(id) mutation (PUT /api/v1/workflows/:id). useDeleteWorkflow(id) mutation (DELETE /api/v1/workflows/:id). useRuns(workflowId) fetching GET /api/v1/workflows/:id/runs. useAllRuns(filters) fetching GET /api/v1/workflows/runs with filter params. useRun(runId) single run detail (GET /api/v1/workflows/runs/:id). useRunTimeline(runId) fetching GET /api/v1/workflows/runs/:id/timeline. useStartRun(workflowId) mutation (POST /api/v1/workflows/:id/runs). useRerunRun(runId) mutation (POST /api/v1/workflows/runs/:id/rerun). useCancelRun(runId) mutation. All use apiClient with proper auth. Cache invalidation on mutations.
implementationPlan.note: Implemented hooks in dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkflows.ts. Deviations from plan: aligned endpoints with gateway routes (use /workflow-runs for run list/detail/timeline and POST /workflows for upsert update). useCancelRun requires workflowId+runId per route.
